_readme: Sources of scripts/find_regdocs.py (compliance/ESG programme, Codex decision 2026-09-25). Order is the rotation order: APPEND new sources at the END. enabled=false sources carry a reason; licence tags outside the current registry vocabulary (unverified, proprietary, cc-by-nd, ...) must stay disabled until the collect-all licence classes land. blocked=true records a reviewed NO-GO and can never run.
